title: Sealing a circuit
statement: Given a circuit with $n$ input vertices, process its dead vertices in order. For each dead vertex $u$, append three gates: a NOT gate reading $u$, an OR gate reading $u$ and the next new vertex, and an AND gate reading the current output and the vertex produced by the OR gate; update the output to the vertex produced by this AND gate. The resulting circuit is the sealed circuit.
